definitions.explanation: The large intestine — the final section of the digestive tract, which absorbs water and forms waste. Contrasts with the {小腸|しょうちょう} (small intestine).

examples.japanese: {大腸|だいちょう}の{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}ける。
{大腸|だいちょう}は{水分|すいぶん}を{吸収|きゅうしゅう}する{働|はたら}きがある。
examples.english: The large intestine functions to absorb water.

examples.japanese: {四十歳|よんじゅっさい}を{過|す}ぎたら{大腸|だいちょう}がんの{検診|けんしん}を{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: After turning forty, I was advised to get screened for colon cancer.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大腸|だいちょう}がん: colon cancer
- {大腸|だいちょう}{検査|けんさ}: colon examination
- {大腸|だいちょう}{菌|きん}: coliform bacteria; E. coli

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小腸|しょうちょう}: small intestine — the section before the large intestine, where most nutrients are absorbed.
